title: $1,656 worth of AI tools for free…👀 #trendingshorts #tech #ai
description:
When we teach a tool inside The Rundown University, we go to the company and ask if our members can have it on us.

Most of the time, they say yes.

Those become our Perks. Free or heavily discounted for paid Rundown University members.

Below are our first five perks:

→ Granola Business (you + 3 teammates) — $672 value
→ Manus Starter — $204 value
→ Higgsfield Starter — $468 value
→ Synthesia Starter — $168 value
→ Typeless Pro — $144 value

Each perk comes with several video guides, so you're not figuring it out alone.

Click the link in my bio to learn more! Or check it out here 👉 https://app.therundown.ai/perks
